en: The Section on Further Exposition, Chapter 14:
The Convergence of the Modes of Conveying by Way of Resolution. In this context, what is the convergence of the modes of conveying by way of resolution?
It is the verse: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range is right intention.”
Therefore, "of one whose mind is guarded" refers to unity.
"The domain of right intention" refers to unity.
The intention of renunciation, the intention of non-ill will, and the intention of non-cruelty—this is diversity.
Having right view as one's primary concern—this is unity.
Right view is that which is knowledge of suffering, knowledge of the origin of suffering, knowledge of the cessation of suffering, and [knowledge] of the way leading to the cessation of suffering.
Knowledge of the way, knowledge of the path, knowledge of the cause, knowledge of phenomena arisen from causes,
knowledge of the condition, and knowledge of phenomena arisen from conditions— that which therein is the knowledge and vision according to reality,
the convergence, the penetration, and the arrival at the truths— this is the diversity.

Having understood "oneness" as the arising and passing away [of phenomena]: through arising, with ignorance as condition there are volitional formations, and with volitional formations as condition there is consciousness;

thus everything comes to be by way of origination. Through passing away, with the cessation of ignorance there is the cessation of volitional formations; thus everything comes to be by way of cessation—this is "diversity.
"A bhikkhu overcome by sloth and torpor": this is "oneness. Sloth is that unwieldiness and lack of serviceability of the mind; torpor is that sluggishness of the body—this is "diversity."

"One abandons all miserable destinies through unity": here, in comparison with gods and humans, the states of deprivation are "miserable destinies"; in comparison with Nibbāna, all forms of rebirth are "miserable destinies"—this is the diversity.
The section on the Modes of Conveying the Foundation is concluded.
